DUE_RULE: due only if (new completed bar > current asof AND engine emit for signal lane) OR (post_asof_trading_days >= horizon N for maturity lane)
WAIT_RULE: WAIT if no new completed bar, or identical emit (CAPTURED_ALREADY), or post_asof_trading_days < N, or provenance/filename-only/Yahoo-geometry block, or discovery pooled as confirmation
note_cadence: CADENCE ≠ WAKE FREQUENCY. Weekly wake only ASKS self-due. SHORT/MEDIUM/LONG are information/maturity scales, not daily/every-N-day run commands.
